title: Case REQ-20261111-LIF004 — earnings evidence
content:
Earnings evidence for Tom Bradley (CL-102265), trading as Bradley Electrical (sole trader), collected by the Claims Agent's Policy & Evidence Check assistant for Ben (Claims) and checked by the Financial Crime Agent for Felix (Financial Crime). Case REQ-20261111-LIF004.

Period: the 12 months to 30 Sep 2026 — the last four BAS quarters before the injury on 14 Oct 2026.
Documents: business activity statements (BAS) for the four quarters to 30 Sep 2026, and the profit and loss statement for the same 12 months.
Net business income for the 12 months: $96,000 — an average of $8,000 a month.

Document checks (Felix's agent): the BAS, the profit and loss statement and the surgeon's report are legitimate; the figures are consistent across the documents. ✅

Comparison: when Tom applied in 2023, his income was $120,000 a year, which set the insured benefit of $7,000 a month. His net business income in the 12 months before the injury was $96,000, so the benefit is based on the lower figure (see 'Case REQ-20261111-LIF004 — benefit calculation').
